model_annotation: This horizontal bar chart illustrates the number of participants who selected each of seven evaluation criteria, with categories listed along the vertical axis and participant counts along the horizontal axis ranging from 0 to 6. The tallest bar, labeled “Relevant FCs” in dark purple, corresponds to 6 participants. The next tallest, “FC Summary” in dark blue, represents 5 participants. Two criteria — “R” (in medium blue) and “Clarity and Simplicity” (in teal) — are tied at 3 participants each. “Overall Summary” (in green) was selected by 2 participants, while “Filters” and “Veracity Explanation” (both in lighter green shades) were each chosen by only 1 participant. The bars are arranged in descending order of participant count, with no grouping or stacking, and each bar’s length visually corresponds to its numerical value, clearly showing a decreasing trend from top to bottom.
